check_br_domain.description: Check on registro.br whether a .br domain is registered or free to register, and when a registered one expires.
check_br_domain.name: check_br_domain

parameters.description: The domain, such as petrobras.com.br. A name without an ending is checked as .com.br.
parameters.name: domain

domain.description: The domain checked. A bare name is checked as .com.br.

expires_at.description: When the registration expires, for a registered domain.

is_available.description: True when the domain can be registered.

name_servers.description: Its name servers, for a registered domain.

reasons.description: Why it cannot be registered, in Portuguese.

status.description: registro.br's status, such as AVAILABLE, REGISTERED or UNAVAILABLE.

suggestions.description: Other .br endings where the same name is free.

get_bank.description: Get a bank's names, ISPB identifier and headquarters address from its three-digit code, such as 341 for Itaú.
get_bank.name: get_bank

parameters.description: The bank, or its three-digit code, such as 341.
parameters.name: code

code.description: Three-digit bank code (COMPE), such as 341. Empty for institutions without one.

headquarters.description: Headquarters address, as the Central Bank lists it.

ispb.description: 8-digit ISPB identifier used in transfers and PIX.

logo_url.description: Address of the bank's logo, when there is one.

get_exchange_rate.description: Get the Central Bank's rate for a currency in reais on a date. For a weekend or holiday, the last business day before it is used.
get_exchange_rate.display_str_template: Get an exchange rate with BrasilAPI.
get_exchange_rate.name: get_exchange_rate

parameters.description: The currency, such as USD or EUR.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The day to get the rate for. It can't be in the future.
parameters.name: date

bulletin.description: Which bulletin buy_rate and sell_rate come from, such as PTAX closing.

buy_rate.description: Reais per unit of the currency, buying, from the day's closing PTAX bulletin (or its last one).

date.description: The date the rates are from: the last business day on or before the date asked for.

quotes.description: Every bulletin of the day, in order.

buy_parity.description: Units of the currency per US dollar, buying.

sell_parity.description: Units of the currency per US dollar, selling.

sell_rate.description: Reais per unit of the currency, selling.

get_interest_rates.description: Get Brazil's official rates: SELIC (the Central Bank's base rate), CDI (the interbank rate) and IPCA (inflation), in percent.
get_interest_rates.display_str_template: Get Brazilian interest rates with BrasilAPI.
get_interest_rates.name: get_interest_rates

cdi.description: CDI, the interbank rate, in percent a year.

ipca.description: IPCA, official inflation over the last 12 months, in percent.

selic.description: SELIC, the Central Bank's base rate, in percent a year.

get_vehicle_price.description: Get the average price of a vehicle in the FIPE table: pick the type, then the brand, model and year. Also gives its FIPE code.
get_vehicle_price.display_str_template: Get a FIPE vehicle price with BrasilAPI.
get_vehicle_price.name: get_vehicle_price

parameters.description: Cars, motorcycles or trucks.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

parameters.description: The brand, or its FIPE brand code, such as 21 for Fiat.
parameters.name: brand

parameters.description: The model, or its FIPE model code.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The model year and fuel, or its code, such as 2020-1. 32000 is a brand-new (zero km) vehicle.
parameters.name: year

fipe_code.description: FIPE code of the model, as 001004-9.

fuel.description: Fuel, such as Gasolina, Álcool, Flex or Diesel.

model_year.description: Model year. 32000 means a brand-new (zero km) vehicle.

price_text.description: The price as FIPE writes it, such as R$ 4.890,00.

reference_month.description: The month the price is for, in Portuguese.

list_banks.description: List Brazil's banks and payment institutions with their three-digit codes and ISPB identifiers, ordered by code.
list_banks.name: list_banks

parameters.description: Keep only entries whose name contains this. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: search

banks.description: Banks and payment institutions, by code.

code.description: Three-digit bank code (COMPE), such as 341. Empty for institutions without one.

ispb.description: 8-digit ISPB identifier used in transfers and PIX.

count.description: How many entries the list holds.

list_brokers.description: List the brokerage firms (corretoras) registered with the CVM, Brazil's securities regulator, with their CNPJ and contacts.
list_brokers.name: list_brokers

parameters.description: Only brokers based in this state. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Keep only entries whose name contains this. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Leave on to skip brokers whose registration was cancelled, which are most of the list.
parameters.name: active_only

net_worth_date.description: Date of the net worth figure.

count.description: How many entries the list holds.

list_holidays.description: List Brazil's national holidays for a year, moveable ones such as Carnaval included. Choose a state to add its own holidays.

holidays.name: Aniversário da Cidade de São Paulo

list_holidays.name: list_holidays

parameters.description: The year, from 1900 to 2199. Leave empty for this year.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Add this state's holidays to the national ones. Leave empty for national holidays only.
parameters.name: state

count.description: How many entries the list holds.

state.description: The state, for a state holiday.

weekday.description: Day of the week, in English.

state.description: The state whose holidays were added, when one was chosen.

list_pix_participants.description: List the banks and payment institutions taking part in PIX, Brazil's instant payment system, with their ISPB identifiers.
list_pix_participants.name: list_pix_participants

parameters.description: Keep only entries whose name contains this. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Return at most this many participants.
parameters.name: limit

modality.description: How it takes part, such as Provedor de Conta Transacional (account provider).

started_on.description: Date it started on PIX, when published.

total_matching.description: How many matched, before Max results.

list_vehicle_brands.description: List the car, motorcycle or truck brands in the FIPE table, Brazil's reference for used vehicle prices, with their codes.
list_vehicle_brands.display_str_template: List FIPE vehicle brands with BrasilAPI.
list_vehicle_brands.name: list_vehicle_brands

parameters.description: Cars, motorcycles or trucks.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

code.description: FIPE brand code, used to pick models.

count.description: How many entries the list holds.

lookup_cep.description: Get the street, neighborhood, city and state of a CEP (Brazilian postal code), with map coordinates when known. The coordinates are often the city's centre rather than the street's.
lookup_cep.display_str_template: Look up a CEP with BrasilAPI.
lookup_cep.name: lookup_cep

parameters.description: The 8-digit postal code, with or without the hyphen, such as 01001-000.
parameters.name: cep

has_coordinates.description: Whether latitude and longitude are filled in.

latitude.description: Latitude, when BrasilAPI knows where the CEP is.

longitude.description: Longitude, when BrasilAPI knows where the CEP is.

source.description: The service BrasilAPI found the address in.

state.description: Two-letter state code, such as SP.

street.description: Street name. Empty for a CEP that covers a whole town.

lookup_cnpj.description: Get a company's public registration from its CNPJ (Brazilian company number): legal and trade names, status, activities, address, phone and partners.
lookup_cnpj.display_name: Look up a company by CNPJ
lookup_cnpj.display_str_template: Look up a CNPJ with BrasilAPI.

mock_response.main_activity: Extração de petróleo e gás natural

secondary_activities.description: Fabricação de produtos do refino de petróleo
Produção de gás; processamento de gás natural

lookup_cnpj.name: lookup_cnpj

parameters.description: The 14-digit company number, with or without punctuation, such as 33.000.167/0001-01.
parameters.name: cnpj

company_size.description: Size class: MICRO EMPRESA, EMPRESA DE PEQUENO PORTE or DEMAIS.

is_active.description: True when the status is ATIVA.

is_headquarters.description: True for the head office (matriz), false for a branch (filial).

legal_nature.description: Legal form, such as Sociedade Anônima Aberta.

mei.description: Whether it is an MEI (individual micro-entrepreneur); empty when unknown.

role.description: Their role, such as Diretor or Sócio-Administrador.

phone.description: Phone number with its DDD (area code).

simples_nacional.description: Whether the company is in the Simples Nacional tax regime; empty when unknown.

status.description: Registration status as the Receita Federal gives it, such as ATIVA (active) or BAIXADA (closed).

trade_name.description: Trade name (nome fantasia), when there is one.

lookup_ddd.description: Find the state and cities a DDD (the two-digit phone area code, such as 11 for São Paulo) covers.
lookup_ddd.display_name: Look up a DDD area code
lookup_ddd.display_str_template: Look up a DDD with BrasilAPI.
lookup_ddd.name: lookup_ddd

parameters.description: The two-digit area code, such as 21.
parameters.name: ddd

cities.description: Cities that use it, A to Z.

state.description: Two-letter code of the state it is in.

lookup_isbn.description: Get a book's title, authors, publisher, synopsis and details from its ISBN. Best for books published in Brazil.
lookup_isbn.display_name: Look up a book by ISBN
lookup_isbn.display_str_template: Look up an ISBN with BrasilAPI.

mock_response.synopsis: Publicada originalmente em 1949, a distopia futurista 1984 é um dos romances mais influentes do século XX.

lookup_isbn.name: lookup_isbn

parameters.description: The 10- or 13-digit ISBN, with or without hyphens, such as 978-85-359-1484-9.
parameters.name: isbn

source.description: The catalogue the book was found in, such as cbl.

search_ncm.description: Find NCM codes, the Mercosur product codes used on Brazilian invoices and customs forms, by code or by description.
search_ncm.name: search_ncm

parameters.description: A code such as 0901.11.10, or words from the description in Portuguese, such as café torrado.
parameters.name: query

count.description: How many entries the list holds.

valid_until.description: Date it ends; 9999-12-31 while in force.

description: Look up Brazilian public data: addresses by CEP, companies by CNPJ, banks, DDD area codes, holidays, FIPE vehicle prices, books by ISBN, NCM codes, PIX participants, .br domains, interest and exchange rates and CVM brokers.
